question: Which of the following drugs obtained by means of molecular engineering techniques is not applicable in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis ?:

CHAIN: "Denosumab" -> "RANKL inhibitor" -> "reduces bone resorption" -> "not primarily indicated for rheumatoid arthritis" -> 80%
CHAIN: "Adalimumab" -> "TNF-alpha inhibitor" -> "reduces inflammation" -> "used in rheumatoid arthritis" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Anakinra" -> "IL-1 receptor antagonist" -> "reduces inflammation" -> "used in rheumatoid arthritis" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Etanercept" -> "TNF receptor fusion protein" -> "reduces inflammation" -> "used in rheumatoid arthritis" -> 95%
analysis: Denosumab is primarily used for the treatment of osteoporosis and certain cancers, not for rheumatoid arthritis. The other options (Infliximab, Adalimumab, Anakinra, and Etanercept) are all biologic agents used in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.
